title: Sanv Tas'dal
wikitext: {{stub}} {{Npcbox | name = Sanv Tas'dal | image = Sanv Tas'dal.png | titles = Rift Lord{{Neutral}} [52] [[Learn Of My Past]] | level = ?? | type = Boss | gender = Male | faction = Boss | affiliation = [[Tribe of Sanv]], [[Burning Legion]] | aggro = {{Aggro|-1|-1}} | race = Draenei | creature = Demon | location = [[Temple of Aka'Sha]], [[Tower of Karazhan]] | status = Killable | instance = Tower of Karazhan }} '''Sanv Tas'dal''' is a [[draenei]] [[riftwalker]] and the sixth boss of [[Tower of Karazhan]]. The chieftain of the [[Tribe of Sanv]], he ordered his people to flee from the dying world of [[Draenor]] after the destruction wrought by the [[orcish Horde]]. However, while part of his tribe escaped to the world of [[Azeroth]] led by [[Akh Z'ador]] and [[Sanv K'la]], Sanv Tas'dal did not follow. He and the remainder of his tribe became servants of the [[Burning Legion]], plying their riftwalking abilities to the demons' cause. When Akh Z'ador attempted to communicate with his remaining tribe, he discovered their change in allegiance; though he in turn was located within the fabric of the Twisting Nether by Sanv Tas'dal, who interrupted his focus, throwing him through the Nether back to Azeroth, in [[Azshara]]. After discovering the location of his tribesmen, Sanv Tas'dal sent a projection of himself to the [[Harborage]] to reunite his people and bring them into the fold under the Legion by force if necessary. ==Quotes== [[File:Projection of Sanv Tas'dal.png|thumb|right|Sanv Tas'dal's projection in the Harborage.]] : ''Main article: [[Fate Of The Harborage#Notes]]'' ;Aggro :Have the vigors of warp travel dampened your mind? Do you not sense the foolishness of fighting Sanv Tas'dal? ;Overflowing Hatred :Behold the great power of the Draenei! ;Death :The hatred, it is lifted...
